scored_object.reference_peak_rule: The series' all-time high as of the shakedown. At bootstrap (2026-11-01, SFR-only series) that is Jan 2025 = $1,776,795; the Jan 2026 local high ($1,758,783) is NOT the reference.
scored_object.calibration_note: SFR-only series. Base (-8 to -15) = the 2022-23 (-12.6%) and 2018-19 (-9.2%) magnitudes; Bear (<= -15) is beyond any rate-shock episode and needs a jobs shock; 2008 was -29.9.

partition_rule: Exclusive bounds: bear if drawdown <= -15; base if -15 < drawdown <= -8; bull if drawdown > -8 (shallower than -8).

weight_moves.label: chat Claude -> v1.1
weight_moves.readings_cited: brief Part 1.1 table (no stored readings exist yet)
weight_moves.reason: (a) the bear path is a five-link conjunction; (b) local labor, rents, sales volume and months-of-supply are all inconsistent with a crash regime today; (c) a steep yield curve and ~18.7x forward P/E argue against the 2000 analog; (d) the IPO calendar is a live counter-current. Bull is cut because it needs a Hormuz deal Iran currently calls unacceptable and a Fed that stops hiking with CPI at 3.7%.
weight_moves.opposite_case: Credit spreads at 2009 levels have never been noise; private-credit defaults at a record with a 2027-28 maturity wall; Alphabet -30% says the market has already begun punishing the build-out; the Fed is hiking into +29k payrolls, which is how soft landings end. If this move is wrong, it's because local data lags the credit cycle by two to three quarters.
weight_moves.reverses_if: Any one tripwire among {two consecutive months of SCC WARN workers >50% YoY, ANT pulled or below issue, CCC OAS beyond its 2010-2025 maximum} moves Bear back above 50. (Tripwire checkpoints are exempt from the three-dial rule, brief 3.4.)

scoring.probability_changes: any monthly checkpoint, logged like a weight move
scoring.auto_resolution: Claims with an `auto` rule resolve from stored readings at each review (lib/marketCycle/autoclaims.ts): `any` = true the first time the condition holds in the window, false once the window has closed; `all` = false the first time it fails, true once the window has closed; `at` = one print; `low_in` = the window's lowest reading falls in [low_from, low_to] and the window's last reading is above it. Months are matched on as_of; dates on the day. The model never resolves these (Ryan Q4).

vote_rules.persistence: two consecutive readings outside the band, or one beyond 2 sigma
vote_rules.weights_move_when: 3+ dials from 2+ categories vote the same way, or a claim resolves, or a tripwire fired
vote_rules.move_requires: log row citing >=2 readings and a non-empty opposite case (move #0 excepted as bootstrap)
vote_rules.corridor_note: Authored thresholds live in each dial's corridor. Bootstrap-computed seasonal stats are stored under corridor.computed and never overwrite authored keys. seasonal_1sd applies only to flow/count series (payrolls, claims, Realtor.com counts, C.A.R. sales).

checkpoint_schedule.monthly: Data-ready (Ryan 2026-11-07): the first Monday on/after the 15th once last month's CPI and Zillow ZHVI prints are both stored; never on a day with an FOMC decision that day or in the next 3 days (it slides a week); from the last Monday of the month it runs whatever has arrived. Once per month. Dates here are the expected ones; lib/marketCycle/schedule.ts decides.
checkpoint_schedule.calendar_sources: CPI: bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm (published through the Nov 2027 print, fetched 2026-11-07). FOMC: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (2027 + Jan 2028, fetched 2026-11-07). Add the rest of 2028 when published.

geographies.property_type_rule: Single-family is the scored lens everywhere. Condo/townhome data is a separate, display-only view; never blended into a scored number.

changes_from_1_1: Two bets (Ryan 2026-11-07): SCC houses (unchanged scenarios and weights) and US stocks (S&P 500, new). Each bet has its own scenarios, odds, dials, claims and weight-move log.
Every scenario carries a low window and a rebound window (Ryan: 'when does the low occur and when do things rebound').
S&P bands aligned to 25 / 10 (Q2). The local tech basket votes in the stock bet only (Q3). C1-C3 and C30 move to the stock bet; C33-C36 are new dated timing claims.
Data-decidable claims carry an `auto` rule and are resolved by code from readings (Q4); the model judges only event claims.
New dials: NASDAQ (stock bet), Zillow single-family levels for the owned zips and for San Mateo / San Francisco / Santa Cruz / Fremont (display only), WARN last-30-days (display only).

bets.name: US stocks — S&P 500
bets.question: Where's the bottom for the S&P 500, and when does it make a new high?

scored_object.description: S&P 500 closing level, maximum drawdown from the Oct 6, 2026 closing high (7,818.93), measured on daily closes through Dec 2028. Watch only — never a buy or sell signal.

bets.partition_rule: Exclusive bounds on the max drawdown from the Oct 6, 2026 close: bear if <= -25; base if -25 < dd <= -10; bull if > -10.

scenarios.name: Bear — "2000–02 again"
scenarios.definition: S&P 500 max drawdown from the Oct 6, 2026 high of -25% or worse through Dec 2028
scenarios.markers: US recession starts in 2027; hyperscalers cut 2027 capex; credit breaks (CCC spread record); IPO window shuts; low in 2028 or later

scenarios.name: Base — "chop, no deep recession"
scenarios.definition: S&P 500 max drawdown from the Oct 6, 2026 high between -10% and -25% through Dec 2028
scenarios.markers: Fed holds 4.25-4.50; 10-yr 4.4-5.0; no or shallow recession; low by late 2027; new high in 2028

scenarios.name: Bull — "Iran deal + IPO money"
scenarios.definition: S&P 500 max drawdown from the Oct 6, 2026 high shallower than -10% through Dec 2028
scenarios.markers: Hormuz reopens; Brent < $90; CPI <= 2.8%; ANT and SpaceX money lands; low before mid-2027, new high by end of 2027

depth_lines.bull: Never falls more than 10% — stays above 7,037

weight_moves.label: stock bet opened (v1.2)
weight_moves.readings_cited: C1-C3 as held on 2026-11-07 (C2 'S&P -25% by Dec 2027' at 40%); S&P 7,689 on Nov 4 (-1.7% from the Oct 6 high); NASDAQ -10.9% from its own Oct 6 high
weight_moves.reason: Starting odds lifted from the stock claims already in the thesis: C2 puts a 25%+ fall at 40%, which is Bear; a 10%+ fall is likelier than not with the NASDAQ already 10.9% off its high, so Base takes 40 and Bull 20.
weight_moves.opposite_case: The broad index is only 1.7% off its high and earnings are still rising; the 2026 sell-off has so far been a tech rotation, not a market-wide break.
weight_moves.reverses_if: The S&P makes a new closing high above 7,818.93 before Mar 2027 with the 10-yr below 4.5% — Bull back above 30.
